user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to census tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point geometries into the census tract layer's projected CRS so the spatial join has compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector layer to EPSG:26918. Preserve all hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Use a spatial containment join to attach the containing census tract identifier to each hospital.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join between the reprojected hospital points and the census tract polygons. Retain one output feature per hospital, preserve hospital attributes, and attach the tract identifier selected from the observed tract schema at runtime. Do not assume or hard-code field names; runtime QC must ground the tract identifier field, expected to be the appropriate identifier field from the tract schema.

requirements.scope: The hospital and census tract inputs to the spatial join must use compatible coordinate reference systems.
Hospital points and census tract polygons used by the spatial join must have valid, non-empty geometries.
The spatial join output must retain hospital identity fields and include the appropriate census tract identifier field from the observed tract schema.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Reprojects vector artifacts between explicitly identified coordinate reference systems and assigns a CRS when explicitly supplied. The service never guesses an unknown CRS.

skills.name: Coordinate Transformation

other: The service does not infer or guess unknown coordinate reference systems.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis A
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector geoprocessing including buffering, clipping, overlay/intersection, explicit geometry repair, and spatial joins. Binary spatial operations require compatible coordinate reference systems. Distance operations use the coordinate system and units of the provided input artifact.

skills.name: Vector Geoprocessing
skills.description: Performs spatial buffering, clipping, polygon intersection overlay, geometry validation/repair, and spatial joins.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for binary operations. Distance operations require projected coordinate reference systems.
other: The service performs only the requested operation.
It does not automatically reproject inputs or repair geometries unless explicitly requested.
